newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse to allow Finance One trading May 30.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse to allow Finance One trading May 30.

text.p: Thailand's stock exchange said on Monday that it would allow trading in suspended Finance One Plc shares to resume from May 30.

Finance One shares were suspended after it announced a planned merger with medium-sized Thai Danu Bank Plc. But the merger plan collapsed last Friday due to tax and other legal problems, the two financial institutions said.
The exchange said that Finance One's management would have to meet with analysts to clarify the firm's financial position prior to a resumption of share trading trade.
The shares are be allowed a 100 percent trading range from their last close with a price floor of 0.10 baht, the exchange said.
Cash-strapped Finance One's securities were suspended at 23.75 baht and last traded on February 28 this year.
The lifting of the trading suspension also applies to Finance One warrants, the statement said.

Finance One, whose asset quality has declined because of unrealised losses on securities and problem loans, was on Friday ordered by the central bank to raise capital by 8.28 billion baht ($318 million) through a two for one rights issue at 7.50 baht per share. ($1 = 26 baht)
